failureMatrix: Failed save retains dirty draft, undo history, debugger state and optimistic base hash; exact retry succeeds.
Concurrent stale workspace cannot overwrite a committed version and retains its own draft.
Edits and undo invalidate old execution; deleted instructions cannot retain orphaned breakpoints.
Invalid edit or invalid/over-capacity context input preserves the previous execution and valid state.
Sensor/resource/signal/clock changes restart execution; players have isolated contexts.
Step/continue share an execution budget and cannot exceed the current host limit or rewrite saved declarations.
Sandbox command honors host duration and zero-message budget; signals are isolated between runs.
Failure in a later bound agent publishes no earlier agent world input or signals; all agents read the prior tick signals.
Initial save failure publishes no program, permits same-ID retry; sealed cross-owner file copies are rejected.
limitations: No new Paper/Folia client or human editor acceptance run; command-thread lifecycle and concurrent production performance remain to validate.
Short command simulations remain ephemeral, limited to 20 steps. Stored typed programs persist; debugger state, sandbox worlds and signals do not survive disconnect/restart.
Resource-world replay verifies mapped inputs, events and state; it is not independent proof of the original typed program and signal history.
Host limit changes can now reject programs that previously bypassed configuration. Valid stored schema-v1 content and hash are unchanged.
Threshold comparison operators other than eq/lt/gt previously faulted only during execution; they now fail validation on edit/load.
Memory-constrained non-forked tests and ephemeral signer keys do not establish production performance or official signing.
The P0-P11 objective remains active and phase gates retain their documented incomplete status.
